programs.title: Intangible Cultural Heritage of Jinpu Ep.4
programs.desc: Through interviews with inheritors and live demonstrations, this program brings Jinzhou's intangible cultural heritage to life. From paper-cutting to dragon dance, it tells the stories behind the traditions that keep the local culture alive.
